blocks.summary: WhatsApp’s new scheduled messages let you choose the right time to send. WhatsApp's 3 billion users are getting an option that Meta says is one of the most requested features, with the ability to schedule messages in advance for both private conversations and group chats.  Most messaging platforms have had this for a very long time, but now it's on WhatsApp too.
